description: Penalty discipline for both teams (accepted flags against, recent and season-long, shrunk toward the league so a three-game streak doesn't count as a trait), turned into points at 0.8 points a flag, with a 95% interval, and priced against the spread. Add the referee once crews post to see the crew's flag rate. Says plainly what has and hasn't held up: crews do differ in how many flags they throw, but home-crowd whistle and crew home bias measure as noise, and crew flag counts haven't beaten the total. For 'who's reffing and does it matter', 'officiating edge in PHI @ DAL', 'does this crew favor the home team', 'which team gets flagged most'.

away.description: Away team, when naming a game.

game.description: The game as written, e.g. "PHI at DAL" or "PHI @ DAL" (away team first).

home.description: Home team, when naming a game.

line.description: Your line for the favoured side, to price the edge (default consensus).

referee.description: Referee's name (last name is enough) once crews are announced, usually midweek.

team.description: Team: abbreviation, city or nickname, e.g. DAL, Dallas, Cowboys.
